title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling examples; docs site quickstart and reference updates
author: Ava Chen
description: This PR adds a set of reusable RAG agent templates, multiple tool-calling examples, and updates the docs site quickstart and reference pages. Motivation: customers frequently ask for opinionated starting points for retrieval-augmented generation and agent-based tool-calling; providing vetted templates + docs will reduce onboarding friction and prevent common integration mistakes. Changes include: 1) a new /examples/rag/agents directory with 4 templates (basic, multi-tool, streaming-aware, and evaluation harness), 2) 3 tool-calling example playbooks demonstrating search + code-exec + calendar APIs, 3) docs site quickstart page with step-by-step setup and troubleshooting tips, and 4) updated reference docs for the agent runtime config and policies. The description below summarizes commits, changed files, CI results, and the review thread. Note: all prose in the docs site was kept concise and focused on real production considerations (timeouts, KV cache hints, and security notes for tool integrations).
commits: Initial add: rag agent templates and basic examples
Add multi-tool agent template and tool adapters for search and calendar

Address review feedback: expand troubleshooting, add env var guidance, update examples to use stable SDK API
Fix linting issues and add test harness for agent examples
review_conversation: Marcus Li: Nice work - these templates should help many customers. A couple of requests: add guidance for token budgets in the quickstart and flag the security considerations for executing code with the code_exec adapter.
Ava Chen: Thanks Marcus - added a troubleshooting section and explicit security note in rag-quickstart.md, and added an env var example to opt into code execution in the template.
Priya Patel: Can we show an example of using the agent with Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) and an example config for autoscaling behavior? Customers ask about behavior under burst load.

Ava Chen: Added a short Dedicated note in the quickstart and a pointer to the autoscaling guide; included an example runtime config snippet in agent-config.md that demonstrates target throughput and fallback policy.

Diego Alvarez (reviewer): Tests look good; small nit: rename streaming_agent_template.py -> streaming_aware_agent.py for clarity. Also please ensure the playbook uses imports from redwood_sdk v1.4 stable API.
Ava Chen: Renamed file and updated imports to v1.4 API. Re-ran examples tests locally and in CI.

testing_instructions: 1) follow redwood-docs/docs/guides/rag-quickstart.md to set up env and sample data; 2) run tests/examples/rag/test_agent_startup.py; 3) manually run examples/rag/agents/multi_tool_agent_template.py against sandbox adapters; 4) verify docs build locally with 'make docs' and inspect quickstart snippets.
